notes: Bundles that aren't yet activated on this deployment now show an Activate button on the tenant consent panel (was inert text before). Click → creates the multi-tenant Entra app in your home tenant → the row flips to 'Grant admin consent' so you can complete the consent flow in one place

Activation failure (most often: missing Application.ReadWrite.OwnedBy on the Function App's managed identity, which Setup-BasewiserPlatform.ps1 grants at install time) surfaces inline as a red error message so you can see why it failed
